desc: Derive the core reduction: ordered pieces, gap assignment h_j <= g_i, exact-match parity invariant, and answer restricted to -1 / base / base+1.
Implement the linear greedy parity-check algorithm described in NEXT, including early impossibility checks and K==1 handling.
Test on the provided sample plus edge cases: K>M, span_B > span_A, K==1, A==B, parity-obstructed cases, and large T with small N.
Ensure fast I/O and low memory for T up to 2e5 and sum N up to 1e6.
